purpose: Repair non-operational and inconsistent currency alerts reported on Render, including stale quotes, NOT_STARTED health, divergent UI/Pushover status and mobile overflow.
repairs: Added currency checks to the existing five-minute Render Cron entry point.
Replaced process-local NOT_STARTED health with a durable cross-process automatic heartbeat.
Unified manual refresh, manual threshold evaluation and Pushover quote data through currency_alert_service.
Removed the second independent quote fetch and legacy lifecycle update from the manual check action.
Pushover test now refuses to send when a fresh quote cannot be obtained and includes quote, status, thresholds and quote time.
Diagnostic forced-breach test restores the real runtime, latest quote and heartbeat after completion.
Added yfinance intraday, fast_info and download fallback paths.
Replaced seven cramped Streamlit metric columns with a responsive mobile status grid.
Moved wide technical tables and event logs into a collapsed diagnostics section.
Added visible provider errors and preserved stale quote timestamps instead of presenting them as fresh.
